definitions.gloss: prefectures; the 47 administrative divisions of Japan
definitions.explanation: The collective term for Japan's 47 first-level administrative divisions: 1 metropolis (Tokyo-to), 1 territory (Hokkaido), 2 urban prefectures (Osaka-fu, Kyoto-fu), and 43 prefectures (ken).

examples.japanese: {都道府県|とどうふけん}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked up population data by prefecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{都道府県|とどうふけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧で、あと⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{制覇|せいは}→制覇：30027_seiha⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It's my dream to travel to every prefecture, and I have just three left to complete the set.

notes:
The compound combines the four types of first-level administrative divisions in Japan: {都|と} (metropolis: {東京都|とうきょうと}), {道|どう} (territory: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧), ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧ (urban prefecture: {大阪府|おおさかふ} and {京都府|きょうとふ}), and ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (prefecture: the remaining 43).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都道府県|とどうふけん}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (by prefecture)
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{都道府県|とどうふけん} (each prefecture)
- {都道府県|とどうふけん}⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧ (prefectural governor)
- 47{都道府県|とどうふけん} (all 47 prefectures)

Japanese schoolchildren memorize all 47 {都道府県|とどうふけん} and their locations as part of the elementary school curriculum.
